# octoreview

> Multi-tenant review and rating service with image and video review media and configurable storage (local, S3, Azure Blob, GCS), built with Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL. Part of the octoverse family, modelled on octonomy. Status: bootstrapped; release
> line 1 in progress.

Gates: `make check` (fast, toolchain only) and `make release-check` (full). `make help` lists
every target. The API contract is [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml); `make openapi-check`
keeps it, the error catalog, the event catalog and the SDK surface in step with the server.

## Docs

- [Spec of record](docs/spec.md): what the service does, one value per item; wins over every other doc
- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md): product rules, gates and the development pipeline
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): layer map, module ownership and octonomy copy provenance
- [OpenAPI contract](docs/openapi.yaml): every /api/v1 operation, request and response schema; the SDKs vendor it
- [Error codes](docs/errors.md): one section per error code with status, details, fix and recovery
- [Events](docs/events.md): the outbox envelope, webhook signature and every event payload
- [SDK surface](docs/sdk-surface.yaml): each operation's Go, PHP and JS method, retry class and parameters ([table](docs/sdk-surface.md))
- [Deployment](docs/deployment.md): the container image, gunicorn settings, migrations, reverse-proxy timeouts and body limits
- [Storage](docs/storage.md): backends, the S3 IAM policy, bucket CORS and lifecycle rules, compatible stores, check_storage steps
- [Environment](.env.example): every setting with a comment
- [README](README.md)
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
- [Release runbook](docs/release.md)
- [Versioning policy](docs/versioning.md)
- [Rulesets](.github/rulesets/README.md): the live rulesets' reviewable mirror
- [TODOS](TODOS.md): deferred work, each with a trigger
